how.narrator: One person is the narrator and does not play. Everyone else gets a secret role on their phone: tap the card to look, tap again to hide it.
how.night: Night: everyone closes their eyes. The narrator wakes the roles one by one; each does its action quietly, then goes back to sleep.
how.morning: Morning: the narrator says who died. Everyone talks it over and votes one suspect out.
how.win: Repeat until a side wins. The village wins when every wolf is out. The wolves win when they are as many as the villagers. A third faction role has its own way to win: read its card.
